integrity: All public statements refer to the same positive-degree rational representation-valued barcode. Each boundary-rank lower certificate is computed from a complete face enumeration and coupled to an exact upper bound; all 24 signed simplicial actions are enumerated. Originality is relative to inspected sources and subject to unindexed equivalents.
scientific_limitations: Exact S4-module statements hold over the rationals for the graph-shortest-path Vietoris–Rips filtration only. No integral module splitting, equivariant homotopy splitting, Borel equivariant cohomology, or unproved infinite-family generalization is claimed. The nonequivariant homotopy types are previously known.
title: The rational tetrahedral symmetry barcode of the truncated-tetrahedral graph
